name: buffer
label: Buffer
description: Schedule, publish and analyze social media posts across multiple channels with Buffer.

token.label: Access Token
token.description:
**How to get your Buffer access token:**

1. Sign in to Buffer at https://buffer.com and open the [Developer Apps](https://publish.buffer.com/developers/apps) page.
2. Click **Create New App** and fill in the basic details (callback URL can be any placeholder).
3. After the app is created, copy the **Access Token** shown on the app's page.
4. Paste it below.

The token is sent as a Bearer token to the Buffer GraphQL API (https://api.buffer.com).

create_post.label: Create Post
create_post.description: Create a post in Buffer and add it to the queue, share it next, share it now, or schedule it for a custom time.

channelIds.label: Channels
channelIds.description: The Buffer channels to publish to.

text.label: Text
text.description: The text content of the post.

mode.label: Share Mode
mode.description: When and how the post should be published.

dueAt.label: Scheduled Time
dueAt.description: When to publish the post. Required when Share Mode is "Schedule for Custom Time". ISO 8601 (UTC).

schedulingType.label: Scheduling Type
schedulingType.description: Use "Automatic" for channels Buffer can publish to directly. Use "Notification" for channels that require manual publishing via the Buffer mobile app (e.g. Instagram personal accounts).

saveToDraft.label: Save as Draft
saveToDraft.description: Save the post as a draft instead of scheduling it. Drafts are not published until explicitly scheduled.

imageUrls.label: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Public URLs of images to attach to the post.

linkUrl.label: Link URL
linkUrl.description: A link to attach to the post (used as a link preview).

create_idea.label: Create Idea
create_idea.description: Save a new idea to your Buffer Idea Bank.

title.label: Title
title.description: A short title or headline for the idea.

text.label: Text
text.description: The main body of the idea.

imageUrls.label: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Public URLs of images to attach to the idea.

aiAssisted.label: AI Assisted
aiAssisted.description: Mark this idea as created with AI assistance.
